strings.scene.tang.hulao.title: 虎牢
strings.scene.tang.hulao.subtitle: 一战擒两王
strings.vo.01: 秦王李世民围王世充于洛阳。夏王窦建德率众十余万来救。
strings.vo.02: 诸将都劝退兵。秦王说：世充粮尽，内外离心；建德新破孟海公，将骄卒惰。我们据虎牢，扼其咽喉。
strings.vo.03: 秦王留兵继续围洛阳，自己率三千五百人东据虎牢。两军对峙一个多月。
strings.vo.04: 夏军列阵二十里，自辰时到午时，士卒饥倦，都坐在地上，争着饮水。
strings.scene.tang.hulao.fork.prompt: 此刻落笔，循哪一卷而书？
strings.scene.tang.hulao.canon.intro: 虎牢关上，秦王看着东方。夏军的营垒一直排到天边，诸将劝他退兵。
strings.scene.tang.hulao.end.canon: 夏军大溃，窦建德中槊坠马，被擒于牛口渚，应了军中的谶语。秦王带着建德到洛阳城下，王世充出降。
strings.scene.tang.hulao.legend.disclaimer: 以下取自清代通俗小说：蔡东藩《唐史演义》第九回铺陈虎牢之战；“李元霸”等人物出于清代《说唐》系小说，史无其人。对话为小说增饰。
strings.scene.tang.hulao.legend.intro: 说唐故事里，李世民身边有一位天下第一的猛将李元霸，手持双锤，无人能敌。史书中，李渊之子李玄霸十六岁早卒，从未上阵。
strings.scene.tang.hulao.end.legend: 说唐的热闹散去，史书里的虎牢之战依旧。汇流。

style.zh: 中国传统水墨动画：宣纸纹理，焦、浓、重、淡、清五色墨层次，干湿浓淡变化，枯笔飞白与泼墨，大面积留白；笔触随镜头逐笔生成，墨色在纸上自然晕开；水墨黑白灰为主，点缀色克制：金橙、酒红，朱砂红只用于印章、旗帜、血或火光的一点；人物以写意线描为主，面部简笔，不做写实刻画。
style.en: Traditional Chinese ink-wash animation on xuan paper: layered ink tones from scorched black to pale wash, wet-and-dry brushwork, dry-brush flying-white strokes and splashed ink, generous negative space (liubai); strokes draw themselves on camera and bleed naturally into the paper; monochrome black-grey with restrained gold-orange and wine red accents and a touch of vermilion for seals, banners, blood or fire; figures in expressive xieyi line, simplified faces, not photorealistic.

setting.zh: 唐 · 唐武德四年五月（621 年五月）。长安坊市、大明宫、驼队、边塞烽燧。
setting.en: Tang dynasty (618–907), 621 CE — Chang'an wards and markets, Daming Palace, camel caravans, frontier beacon towers.

narration: 秦王李世民围王世充于洛阳。夏王窦建德率众十余万来救。诸将都劝退兵。秦王说：世充粮尽，内外离心；建德新破孟海公，将骄卒惰。我们据虎牢，扼其咽喉。
秦王留兵继续围洛阳，自己率三千五百人东据虎牢。两军对峙一个多月。
夏军列阵二十里，自辰时到午时，士卒饥倦，都坐在地上，争着饮水。
秦王说：可以出击了——

豆入牛口，势不得久

prompt.en:
[Ink-wash video prompt] Tang dynasty (618–907) · "虎牢" (一战擒两王)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 106 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: Traditional Chinese ink-wash animation on xuan paper: layered ink tones from scorched black to pale wash, wet-and-dry brushwork, dry-brush flying-white strokes and splashed ink, generous negative space (liubai); strokes draw themselves on camera and bleed naturally into the paper; monochrome black-grey with restrained gold-orange and wine red accents and a touch of vermilion for seals, banners, blood or fire; figures in expressive xieyi line, simplified faces, not photorealistic.

Setting: Tang dynasty (618–907), 621 CE — Chang'an wards and markets, Daming Palace, camel caravans, frontier beacon towers.

Characters:
- Li Shimin (李世民) — royal / consort, 唐 camp; futou headscarves, round-collar robes, mingguang plate armour; rich court dress, elaborate hair ornaments; age as historically attested in 621 CE
- Yuchi Jingde (尉迟敬德) — general, 唐 camp; futou headscarves, round-collar robes, mingguang plate armour; general in full armour, sword or weapon in hand; age as historically attested in 621 CE
- Dou Jiande (窦建德) — ruler, 夏 camp; futou headscarves, round-collar robes, mingguang plate armour; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; age as historically attested in 621 CE
- Wang Shichong (王世充) — ruler, 郑 camp; futou headscarves, round-collar robes, mingguang plate armour; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; age as historically attested in 621 CE
- Ling Jing (凌敬) — minister, 夏 camp; futou headscarves, round-collar robes, mingguang plate armour; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; age as historically attested in 621 CE

strings.scene.tang.xuanwu.title: 玄武门之变
strings.scene.tang.xuanwu.subtitle: 武德九年
strings.vo.01: 唐初，秦王李世民功高，与太子李建成、齐王李元吉的嫌隙日深。
strings.vo.02: 武德九年六月，秦王府僚属力劝先发制人。
strings.vo.03: 六月四日清晨，建成、元吉入朝，行至临湖殿，察觉有变，拨马欲回。
strings.vo.04: 秦王跃马追呼，引弓射之——
strings.scene.tang.xuanwu.fork.prompt: 此刻落笔，循哪一卷而书？
strings.scene.tang.xuanwu.pick.canon: 正史 · 《旧唐书》、《资治通鉴》所载
strings.scene.tang.xuanwu.canon.intro: 武德九年六月初三，太白复经天。傅奕密奏：太白见秦分，秦王当有天下。高祖把奏章交给了李世民。
strings.scene.tang.xuanwu.end.canon: 建成、元吉被杀。三日后，李世民被立为太子；八月，高祖传位，是为唐太宗。
strings.scene.tang.xuanwu.legend.disclaimer: 以下不是传说，而是史家的考辨：玄武门之变的记载经过唐初史官修订，后世史家对其中细节多有疑问。
strings.scene.tang.xuanwu.legend.intro: 史书记载，唐太宗曾要求阅看本朝国史，史官因此对玄武门之事的写法有所斟酌。后世史家据此讨论：建成、元吉的“谋害”记载有几分可信？
strings.scene.tang.xuanwu.end.legend: 史笔的疑点无法彻底解开。考辨之后，回到正史：贞观之治即将开始。

style.zh: 中国传统水墨动画：宣纸纹理，焦、浓、重、淡、清五色墨层次，干湿浓淡变化，枯笔飞白与泼墨，大面积留白；笔触随镜头逐笔生成，墨色在纸上自然晕开；水墨黑白灰为主，点缀色克制：金橙、酒红，朱砂红只用于印章、旗帜、血或火光的一点；人物以写意线描为主，面部简笔，不做写实刻画。
style.en: Traditional Chinese ink-wash animation on xuan paper: layered ink tones from scorched black to pale wash, wet-and-dry brushwork, dry-brush flying-white strokes and splashed ink, generous negative space (liubai); strokes draw themselves on camera and bleed naturally into the paper; monochrome black-grey with restrained gold-orange and wine red accents and a touch of vermilion for seals, banners, blood or fire; figures in expressive xieyi line, simplified faces, not photorealistic.

prompt.en:
[Ink-wash video prompt] Tang dynasty (618–907) · "玄武门之变" (武德九年)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 106 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: Traditional Chinese ink-wash animation on xuan paper: layered ink tones from scorched black to pale wash, wet-and-dry brushwork, dry-brush flying-white strokes and splashed ink, generous negative space (liubai); strokes draw themselves on camera and bleed naturally into the paper; monochrome black-grey with restrained gold-orange and wine red accents and a touch of vermilion for seals, banners, blood or fire; figures in expressive xieyi line, simplified faces, not photorealistic.

Setting: Tang dynasty (618–907), 626 CE — Chang'an wards and markets, Daming Palace, camel caravans, frontier beacon towers.

strings.scene.tang.weishui.title: 渭水之盟
strings.scene.tang.weishui.subtitle: 李靖破突厥
strings.vo.01: 太宗即位才二十天，突厥颉利可汗率十余万骑直抵渭水便桥之北，长安戒严。
strings.vo.02: 太宗与房玄龄等六骑径出玄武门，至渭水之上，与颉利隔水而语，责其负约。
strings.vo.03: 唐军随后赶到，旌甲蔽野。颉利见太宗从容，又见大军继至，请和。便桥之上，斩白马为盟。
strings.vo.04: 太宗卷甲韬戈，啖以金帛，暂且忍下。四年后，突厥内乱又遇雪灾，李靖率骁骑三千自马邑出发。
strings.scene.tang.weishui.quote: 李陵以步卒五千绝漠，然卒降匈奴，其功尚得书竹帛。卿以三千轻骑深入虏庭
strings.scene.tang.weishui.fork.prompt: 此刻落笔，循哪一卷而书？
strings.scene.tang.weishui.canon.intro: 玄武门外，太宗只带了六个人。渭水对岸，突厥骑兵望不到尽头。
strings.scene.tang.weishui.end.canon: 颉利遁走，被俘送长安。东突厥亡。太上皇李渊闻之叹道：汉高祖困白登，不能报；今我子能灭突厥。西北诸族尊太宗为天可汗。
strings.scene.tang.weishui.legend.disclaimer: 以下按蔡东藩《唐史演义》第十四、十六回改编，主干同正史，对话与细节为小说增饰。
strings.scene.tang.weishui.legend.intro: 演义写太宗在渭水边对颉利侃侃而谈，又写李靖雪夜行军时与将士同饮冰雪。
strings.scene.tang.weishui.end.legend: 盟约与雪夜，演义串起了四年。汇流。

style.zh: 中国传统水墨动画：宣纸纹理，焦、浓、重、淡、清五色墨层次，干湿浓淡变化，枯笔飞白与泼墨，大面积留白；笔触随镜头逐笔生成，墨色在纸上自然晕开；水墨黑白灰为主，点缀色克制：金橙、酒红，朱砂红只用于印章、旗帜、血或火光的一点；人物以写意线描为主，面部简笔，不做写实刻画。
style.en: Traditional Chinese ink-wash animation on xuan paper: layered ink tones from scorched black to pale wash, wet-and-dry brushwork, dry-brush flying-white strokes and splashed ink, generous negative space (liubai); strokes draw themselves on camera and bleed naturally into the paper; monochrome black-grey with restrained gold-orange and wine red accents and a touch of vermilion for seals, banners, blood or fire; figures in expressive xieyi line, simplified faces, not photorealistic.

setting.zh: 唐 · 唐武德九年至贞观四年（626—630 年）。长安坊市、大明宫、驼队、边塞烽燧。
setting.en: Tang dynasty (618–907), 626 CE–630 CE — Chang'an wards and markets, Daming Palace, camel caravans, frontier beacon towers.

characters.name: 唐太宗
characters.zh: 唐太宗（唐·李世民）：幞头，圆领袍，明光铠；君主装束，冠冕或礼服，神情威严；年龄依史实（此时为626—630 年）；即位不久，六骑至渭水与颉利隔水而语，结便桥之盟
characters.en: Tang Taizong (唐太宗) — ruler, 唐 camp; futou headscarves, round-collar robes, mingguang plate armour; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; age as historically attested in 626 CE–630 CE

narration: 太宗即位才二十天，突厥颉利可汗率十余万骑直抵渭水便桥之北，长安戒严。太宗与房玄龄等六骑径出玄武门，至渭水之上，与颉利隔水而语，责其负约。
唐军随后赶到，旌甲蔽野。颉利见太宗从容，又见大军继至，请和。便桥之上，斩白马为盟。
太宗卷甲韬戈，啖以金帛，暂且忍下。四年后，突厥内乱又遇雪灾，李靖率骁骑三千自马邑出发。
夜袭定襄——
颉利遁走，被俘送长安。东突厥亡。太上皇李渊闻之叹道：汉高祖困白登，不能报；今我子能灭突厥。西北诸族尊太宗为天可汗。
李陵以步卒五千绝漠，然卒降匈奴，其功尚得书竹帛。卿以三千轻骑深入虏庭

[Ink-wash video prompt] Tang dynasty (618–907) · "渭水之盟" (李靖破突厥)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 106 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: Traditional Chinese ink-wash animation on xuan paper: layered ink tones from scorched black to pale wash, wet-and-dry brushwork, dry-brush flying-white strokes and splashed ink, generous negative space (liubai); strokes draw themselves on camera and bleed naturally into the paper; monochrome black-grey with restrained gold-orange and wine red accents and a touch of vermilion for seals, banners, blood or fire; figures in expressive xieyi line, simplified faces, not photorealistic.

Setting: Tang dynasty (618–907), 626 CE–630 CE — Chang'an wards and markets, Daming Palace, camel caravans, frontier beacon towers.

Characters:
- Tang Taizong (唐太宗) — ruler, 唐 camp; futou headscarves, round-collar robes, mingguang plate armour; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; age as historically attested in 626 CE–630 CE
- Illig Qaghan (颉利可汗) — ruler, 东突厥 camp; steppe nomad dress: fur-lined robes, felt hats, leather boots, bow and sabre; age as historically attested in 626 CE–630 CE
- Li Jing (李靖) — general, 唐 camp; futou headscarves, round-collar robes, mingguang plate armour; general in full armour, sword or weapon in hand; age as historically attested in 626 CE–630 CE
- Fang Xuanling (房玄龄) — minister, 唐 camp; futou headscarves, round-collar robes, mingguang plate armour; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; age as historically attested in 626 CE–630 CE
- Li Ji (李勣) — general, 唐 camp; futou headscarves, round-collar robes, mingguang plate armour; general in full armour, sword or weapon in hand; age as historically attested in 626 CE–630 CE

strings.scene.tang.xuanzang.title: 西行
strings.scene.tang.xuanzang.subtitle: 玄奘取经
strings.vo.01: 贞观初年，国法不许百姓私出国境。僧人玄奘上表请往天竺求法，没有得到允许。
strings.vo.02: 他混在饥民之中出了长安，到凉州被都督逼还，便昼伏夜行，到了瓜州。
strings.vo.03: 一个胡人石槃陀引他夜过玉门关，半路却拔刀生了悔意。玄奘独自向西，经过五座烽燧。
strings.vo.04: 入莫贺延碛，长八百余里，上无飞鸟，下无走兽，复无水草。他一失手，水囊倾覆了。
strings.scene.tang.xuanzang.quote: 宁可就西而死，岂归东而生
strings.scene.tang.xuanzang.fork.prompt: 此刻落笔，循哪一卷而书？
strings.scene.tang.xuanzang.pick.canon: 正史 · 《大慈恩寺三藏法师传》所载
strings.scene.tang.xuanzang.canon.intro: 第一座烽燧下有一眼泉。玄奘伏在沙丘后面，等天全黑了，才爬过去取水。
strings.scene.tang.xuanzang.end.canon: 贞观十九年正月，玄奘带着六百五十七部经回到长安。太宗召见于洛阳，命他撰《大唐西域记》。此后他在长安译经十九年。
strings.scene.tang.xuanzang.legend.disclaimer: 以下取自明代神魔小说《西游记》（通常题吴承恩撰）：唐僧奉旨西行、孙悟空等弟子相护、九九八十一难，都是小说虚构；真实的玄奘是私自出关。
strings.scene.tang.xuanzang.legend.intro: 小说里，唐太宗与唐僧结为兄弟，赐他通关文牒和白马，送出长安。路上收了三个徒弟和一匹龙马。
strings.scene.tang.xuanzang.end.legend: 小说的取经人有徒弟和法宝，真实的玄奘只有一匹瘦马。汇流。
strings.scene.tang.xuanzang.pick.whatif: 推演 · 若玄奘被逼还长安（未开放）

style.zh: 中国传统水墨动画：宣纸纹理，焦、浓、重、淡、清五色墨层次，干湿浓淡变化，枯笔飞白与泼墨，大面积留白；笔触随镜头逐笔生成，墨色在纸上自然晕开；水墨黑白灰为主，点缀色克制：金橙、酒红，朱砂红只用于印章、旗帜、血或火光的一点；人物以写意线描为主，面部简笔，不做写实刻画。
style.en: Traditional Chinese ink-wash animation on xuan paper: layered ink tones from scorched black to pale wash, wet-and-dry brushwork, dry-brush flying-white strokes and splashed ink, generous negative space (liubai); strokes draw themselves on camera and bleed naturally into the paper; monochrome black-grey with restrained gold-orange and wine red accents and a touch of vermilion for seals, banners, blood or fire; figures in expressive xieyi line, simplified faces, not photorealistic.

shots.vo: 贞观初年，国法不许百姓私出国境。僧人玄奘上表请往天竺求法，没有得到允许。他混在饥民之中出了长安，到凉州被都督逼还，便昼伏夜行，到了瓜州。

shots.vo: 一个胡人石槃陀引他夜过玉门关，半路却拔刀生了悔意。玄奘独自向西，经过五座烽燧。

shots.vo: 贞观十九年正月，玄奘带着六百五十七部经回到长安。太宗召见于洛阳，命他撰《大唐西域记》。此后他在长安译经十九年。

narration: 贞观初年，国法不许百姓私出国境。僧人玄奘上表请往天竺求法，没有得到允许。他混在饥民之中出了长安，到凉州被都督逼还，便昼伏夜行，到了瓜州。
一个胡人石槃陀引他夜过玉门关，半路却拔刀生了悔意。玄奘独自向西，经过五座烽燧。
入莫贺延碛，长八百余里，上无飞鸟，下无走兽，复无水草。他一失手，水囊倾覆了。
他说：宁可就西而死——
贞观十九年正月，玄奘带着六百五十七部经回到长安。太宗召见于洛阳，命他撰《大唐西域记》。此后他在长安译经十九年。

strings.scene.tang.wencheng.title: 文成公主入藏
strings.scene.tang.wencheng.subtitle: 唐蕃和亲
strings.vo.01: 吐蕃赞普弃宗弄赞——后世称松赞干布——听说突厥、吐谷浑都娶了唐公主，也遣使求婚。
strings.vo.02: 求婚不成，他发兵攻松州，被唐军击退，于是谢罪，再次请婚。
strings.vo.03: 贞观十四年，大论禄东赞献金五千两及宝玩数百件。太宗许以宗室女文成公主。
strings.vo.04: 贞观十五年正月，江夏王李道宗持节护送公主入蕃。
strings.scene.tang.wencheng.quote: 我祖父未有通婚上国者，今我得尚大唐公主，为幸实多
strings.scene.tang.wencheng.fork.prompt: 此刻落笔，循哪一卷而书？
strings.scene.tang.wencheng.pick.canon: 正史 · 《旧唐书·吐蕃传》所载
strings.scene.tang.wencheng.canon.intro: 送亲的队伍出了长安，一路向西。越往前走，山越高，天越近。
strings.scene.tang.wencheng.end.canon: 赞普见道宗，执子婿之礼甚恭。他叹服唐的服饰礼仪，为公主别筑一城，自己也释毡裘、袭纨绮。唐蕃此后往来不绝。
strings.scene.tang.wencheng.legend.disclaimer: 以下是藏汉民间流传的故事：禄东赞在长安与各国使者竞争，太宗出五道难题，他一一解答。史书不载，藏戏中亦有演述。阎立本《步辇图》绘太宗接见禄东赞的场景（今存宋摹本）。
strings.scene.tang.wencheng.legend.intro: 传说太宗出题：用丝线穿过九曲明珠，分辨一百匹母马和一百匹马驹谁是谁的孩子……禄东赞都想出了办法。
strings.scene.tang.wencheng.end.legend: 传说里禄东赞胜了；史书里，太宗许婚。汇流。
strings.scene.tang.wencheng.pick.whatif: 推演 · 若吐蕃不再请婚（未开放）

style.zh: 中国传统水墨动画：宣纸纹理，焦、浓、重、淡、清五色墨层次，干湿浓淡变化，枯笔飞白与泼墨，大面积留白；笔触随镜头逐笔生成，墨色在纸上自然晕开；水墨黑白灰为主，点缀色克制：金橙、酒红，朱砂红只用于印章、旗帜、血或火光的一点；人物以写意线描为主，面部简笔，不做写实刻画。
style.en: Traditional Chinese ink-wash animation on xuan paper: layered ink tones from scorched black to pale wash, wet-and-dry brushwork, dry-brush flying-white strokes and splashed ink, generous negative space (liubai); strokes draw themselves on camera and bleed naturally into the paper; monochrome black-grey with restrained gold-orange and wine red accents and a touch of vermilion for seals, banners, blood or fire; figures in expressive xieyi line, simplified faces, not photorealistic.

setting.zh: 唐 · 唐贞观十五年正月（641 年正月）。长安坊市、大明宫、驼队、边塞烽燧。
setting.en: Tang dynasty (618–907), 641 CE — Chang'an wards and markets, Daming Palace, camel caravans, frontier beacon towers.

characters.name: 文成公主
characters.zh: 文成公主（唐·宗室女）：女子高腰襦裙与披帛，高髻；宫廷华服，发髻首饰精致；年龄依史实（此时为641 年正月）；贞观十五年嫁吐蕃赞普
characters.en: Princess Wencheng (文成公主) — royal / consort, 唐 camp; high-waisted ruqun with silk shawls, high chignon; rich court dress, elaborate hair ornaments; age as historically attested in 641 CE

characters.name: 松赞干布
characters.zh: 松赞干布（吐蕃·弃宗弄赞，吐蕃赞普）：吐蕃装束：赭面、长袍、高帽；年龄依史实（此时为641 年正月）；遣使求婚，亲迎于柏海，为公主筑城
characters.en: Songtsen Gampo (松赞干布) — ruler, 吐蕃 camp; Tibetan (Tubo) dress: ochre-painted face, long robe, tall hat; age as historically attested in 641 CE

characters.name: 禄东赞
characters.zh: 禄东赞（吐蕃·吐蕃大论）：吐蕃装束：赭面、长袍、高帽；年龄依史实（此时为641 年正月）；奉命献金五千两求婚
characters.en: Gar Tongtsen (禄东赞) — minister, 吐蕃 camp; Tibetan (Tubo) dress: ochre-painted face, long robe, tall hat; age as historically attested in 641 CE

characters.name: 李道宗
characters.zh: 李道宗（唐·江夏王）：幞头，圆领袍，明光铠；宫廷华服，发髻首饰精致；年龄依史实（此时为641 年正月）；持节护送公主入蕃
characters.en: Li Daozong (李道宗) — royal / consort, 唐 camp; futou headscarves, round-collar robes, mingguang plate armour; rich court dress, elaborate hair ornaments; age as historically attested in 641 CE

characters.name: 唐太宗
characters.zh: 唐太宗（唐·李世民）：幞头，圆领袍，明光铠；君主装束，冠冕或礼服，神情威严；年龄依史实（此时为641 年正月）；许婚
characters.en: Tang Taizong (唐太宗) — ruler, 唐 camp; futou headscarves, round-collar robes, mingguang plate armour; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; age as historically attested in 641 CE

narration: 吐蕃赞普弃宗弄赞——后世称松赞干布——听说突厥、吐谷浑都娶了唐公主，也遣使求婚。求婚不成，他发兵攻松州，被唐军击退，于是谢罪，再次请婚。
贞观十四年，大论禄东赞献金五千两及宝玩数百件。太宗许以宗室女文成公主。
贞观十五年正月，江夏王李道宗持节护送公主入蕃。
赞普率兵到柏海迎接——

strings.scene.tang.wuzetian.title: 无字碑
strings.scene.tang.wuzetian.subtitle: 武则天
strings.vo.01: 唐高宗死后，武后临朝称制，先后废立中宗、睿宗。
strings.vo.02: 天授元年，她改国号为周，自称圣神皇帝，成为中国历史上唯一的女皇帝。
strings.vo.03: 晚年，宰相狄仁杰力劝复立庐陵王李显为太子，又举荐张柬之。
strings.vo.04: 神龙元年正月，张柬之等率羽林军入宫，诛张易之、张昌宗，迫武则天传位。
strings.vo.05: 她死后葬于乾陵，陵前立一碑——
strings.scene.tang.wuzetian.fork.prompt: 此刻落笔，循哪一卷而书？
strings.scene.tang.wuzetian.pick.canon: 正史 · 《旧唐书》、《新唐书》所载
strings.scene.tang.wuzetian.canon.intro: 神龙元年正月，洛阳宫中，女皇卧病于迎仙宫。张柬之等人已经约定了日子。
strings.scene.tang.wuzetian.end.canon: 中宗复位，恢复唐的国号。武则天同年病逝，遗制去帝号，称则天大圣皇后。
strings.scene.tang.wuzetian.legend.disclaimer: 以下取自清代李汝珍的小说《镜花缘》，武则天令百花冬开、牡丹被贬洛阳是小说虚构。
strings.scene.tang.wuzetian.legend.intro: 《镜花缘》写武则天醉后于寒冬下诏，令上苑百花一夜齐放；百花仙子不敢违命，唯牡丹迟开，被贬洛阳。
strings.scene.tang.wuzetian.end.legend: 牡丹去了洛阳。小说的故事落在花园里，正史照常前行：神龙政变，李唐复辟。
strings.scene.tang.wuzetian.pick.whatif: 推演 · 若武则天立武氏子侄（未开放）

style.zh: 中国传统水墨动画：宣纸纹理，焦、浓、重、淡、清五色墨层次，干湿浓淡变化，枯笔飞白与泼墨，大面积留白；笔触随镜头逐笔生成，墨色在纸上自然晕开；水墨黑白灰为主，点缀色克制：金橙、酒红，朱砂红只用于印章、旗帜、血或火光的一点；人物以写意线描为主，面部简笔，不做写实刻画。
style.en: Traditional Chinese ink-wash animation on xuan paper: layered ink tones from scorched black to pale wash, wet-and-dry brushwork, dry-brush flying-white strokes and splashed ink, generous negative space (liubai); strokes draw themselves on camera and bleed naturally into the paper; monochrome black-grey with restrained gold-orange and wine red accents and a touch of vermilion for seals, banners, blood or fire; figures in expressive xieyi line, simplified faces, not photorealistic.

setting.zh: 唐 · 武周天授元年至神龙元年（690—705 年）。长安坊市、大明宫、驼队、边塞烽燧。
setting.en: Tang dynasty (618–907), 690 CE–705 CE — Chang'an wards and markets, Daming Palace, camel caravans, frontier beacon towers.

narration: 唐高宗死后，武后临朝称制，先后废立中宗、睿宗。天授元年，她改国号为周，自称圣神皇帝，成为中国历史上唯一的女皇帝。
晚年，宰相狄仁杰力劝复立庐陵王李显为太子，又举荐张柬之。
神龙元年正月，张柬之等率羽林军入宫，诛张易之、张昌宗，迫武则天传位。
她死后葬于乾陵，陵前立一碑——
中宗复位，恢复唐的国号。武则天同年病逝，遗制去帝号，称则天大圣皇后。

prompt.en:
[Ink-wash video prompt] Tang dynasty (618–907) · "无字碑" (武则天)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 106 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: Traditional Chinese ink-wash animation on xuan paper: layered ink tones from scorched black to pale wash, wet-and-dry brushwork, dry-brush flying-white strokes and splashed ink, generous negative space (liubai); strokes draw themselves on camera and bleed naturally into the paper; monochrome black-grey with restrained gold-orange and wine red accents and a touch of vermilion for seals, banners, blood or fire; figures in expressive xieyi line, simplified faces, not photorealistic.

Setting: Tang dynasty (618–907), 690 CE–705 CE — Chang'an wards and markets, Daming Palace, camel caravans, frontier beacon towers.

Characters:
- Wu Zetian (武则天) — ruler, 武周 camp; futou headscarves, round-collar robes, mingguang plate armour; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; age as historically attested in 690 CE–705 CE
- Di Renjie (狄仁杰) — minister, 武周 camp; futou headscarves, round-collar robes, mingguang plate armour; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; age as historically attested in 690 CE–705 CE
- Zhang Jianzhi (张柬之) — minister, 武周 camp; futou headscarves, round-collar robes, mingguang plate armour; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; age as historically attested in 690 CE–705 CE
- Shangguan Waner (上官婉儿) — minister, 武周 camp; futou headscarves, round-collar robes, mingguang plate armour; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; age as historically attested in 690 CE–705 CE
- Li Xian (李显) — royal / consort, 唐 camp; high-waisted ruqun with silk shawls, high chignon; rich court dress, elaborate hair ornaments; age as historically attested in 690 CE–705 CE
- Zhang Yizhi (张易之) — commoner, 武周 camp; futou headscarves, round-collar robes, mingguang plate armour; commoner, artisan, attendant or soldier clothing as appropriate; age as historically attested in 690 CE–705 CE

Storyboard:
Shot 1 (0–10 s, 10 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: background: distant mountains; midground: crenellated city wall, palace pillars, palace eaves | Action: (scene action, Chinese) 洛阳神都，明堂 | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper | Sound: ambience: palace hall reverb | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「无字碑」 with vermilion seal 「天授」
Shot 2 (10–26 s, 16 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: Wu Zetian, banners | Action: (scene action, Chinese) 天授元年，改唐为周 | Ink FX: ink-bleed transition from the previous shot | Sound: ambience: palace hall reverb; SFX: bronze bell | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「唐高宗死后，武后临朝称制，先后废立中宗、睿宗。天授元年，她改国号为周，自称圣神皇帝，成为中国历史上唯一的女皇帝。」
Shot 3 (26–50 s, 24 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: scroll; subject: Di Renjie | Action: (scene action, Chinese) 狄仁杰进言，荐张柬之 | Ink FX: ink-bleed transition from the previous shot | Sound: ambience: palace hall reverb; SFX: bamboo slips rustling | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「晚年，宰相狄仁杰力劝复立庐陵王李显为太子，又举荐张柬之。」
Shot 4 (50–78 s, 28 s) | Camera: subtle handheld shake, urgent rhythm | Composition: background: moon; subject: Zhang Jianzhi, army ranks, forest of spears | Action: (scene action, Chinese) 神龙元年正月，羽林军入宫 | Ink FX: ink-bleed transition from the previous shot | Sound: ambience: night wind; SFX: footsteps | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「神龙元年正月，张柬之等率羽林军入宫，诛张易之、张昌宗，迫武则天传位。」
Shot 5 (78–90 s, 12 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: background: textured rocks; midground: 无字; dry-brush calligraphy 「无字碑」 | Action: (scene action, Chinese) 乾陵，一块无字之碑 | Ink FX: ink-bleed transition from the previous shot; vignette closing in from the corners; freeze into a still ink painting; ink splash with a single vermilion accent | Sound: ambience: lingering wind after battle; SFX: bronze bell | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「她死后葬于乾陵，陵前立一碑——」
Shot 6 (90–100 s, 10 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; distant landscape | Action: (canonical outcome, Chinese) 中宗复位，恢复唐的国号。武则天同年病逝，遗制去帝号，称则天大圣皇后。 | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「中宗复位，恢复唐的国号。武则天同年病逝，遗制去帝号，称则天大圣皇后。」
Shot 7 (100–106 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper; a vertical kaishu quotation; vermilion seal 「天授」 at lower right | Action: the quotation writes itself stroke by stroke; the vermilion seal stamps last | Ink FX: brush writes stroke by stroke, vermilion seal paste slightly bleeding | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | On-screen text: quotation and its source

Sound: Music: pipa lute, tense tremolo or wistful phrases, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: palace hall reverb, night wind, lingering wind after battle; SFX: bronze bell, bamboo slips rustling, footsteps; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

On-screen text: Title: vertical brush calligraphy 「无字碑」, subtitle 「武则天」, vermilion seal 「天授」 at upper right; subtitles: Simplified Chinese, bottom centre; all Chinese text must be exact, no garbled or Latin text.

strings.scene.tang.anshi.title: 渔阳鼙鼓
strings.scene.tang.anshi.subtitle: 安史之乱与马嵬
strings.vo.01: 天宝十四载十一月，安禄山在范阳起兵，以讨杨国忠为名，南下河北。
strings.vo.02: 一个月后，洛阳失守。次年六月，哥舒翰被迫出潼关迎战，大败。
strings.vo.03: 玄宗仓皇出奔。行至马嵬驿，将士饥疲，陈玄礼请诛杨国忠。
strings.vo.04: 杨国忠被乱兵所杀。六军仍然不肯前行。
strings.scene.tang.anshi.fork.prompt: 此刻落笔，循哪一卷而书？
strings.scene.tang.anshi.pick.canon: 正史 · 《旧唐书》、《旧唐书》所载
strings.scene.tang.anshi.canon.intro: 天宝十五载六月，潼关失守。天还没亮，玄宗带着贵妃姐妹与亲近之人出了延秋门。
strings.scene.tang.anshi.end.canon: 贵妃被缢死于佛堂。玄宗入蜀，太子北上灵武即位，是为肃宗。平叛之战还要持续七年。
strings.scene.tang.anshi.legend.disclaimer: 以下取自白居易的诗《长恨歌》以及后世传说。仙山相会是诗人的想象；贵妃东渡日本之说也只是传说。
strings.scene.tang.anshi.legend.intro: 《长恨歌》写玄宗回长安后思念贵妃，临邛道士上穷碧落下黄泉，在海上仙山找到了她。她托道士带回一枚钿合、一股金钗。
strings.scene.tang.anshi.end.legend: 钿合金钗留在了诗里。诗与传说之外，正史依旧：安史之乱延续多年。

style.zh: 中国传统水墨动画：宣纸纹理，焦、浓、重、淡、清五色墨层次，干湿浓淡变化，枯笔飞白与泼墨，大面积留白；笔触随镜头逐笔生成，墨色在纸上自然晕开；水墨黑白灰为主，点缀色克制：金橙、酒红，朱砂红只用于印章、旗帜、血或火光的一点；人物以写意线描为主，面部简笔，不做写实刻画。
style.en: Traditional Chinese ink-wash animation on xuan paper: layered ink tones from scorched black to pale wash, wet-and-dry brushwork, dry-brush flying-white strokes and splashed ink, generous negative space (liubai); strokes draw themselves on camera and bleed naturally into the paper; monochrome black-grey with restrained gold-orange and wine red accents and a touch of vermilion for seals, banners, blood or fire; figures in expressive xieyi line, simplified faces, not photorealistic.

sound.zh: 背景乐：琵琶，铿锵急切或婉转低回，随剧情由缓入急、高潮前骤停留白；环境声：琴室、远处厮杀声、人群低语、战后余风；音效：远处鼓声、马蹄声、兵刃相击、低语、衣袂摩挲；旁白：普通话，沉稳舒缓的纪录片语气，逐镜如下。
sound.en: Music: pipa lute, tense tremolo or wistful phrases, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: guqin room tone, distant battle, crowd murmur, lingering wind after battle; SFX: distant drums, hoofbeats, clashing weapons, murmuring, rustling silk; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

onScreenText.zh: 片头：右上竖排书法片名「渔阳鼙鼓」，副题「安史之乱与马嵬」，朱印「马嵬」；旁白字幕：简体中文，底部居中，楷体或宋体，白底留边；所有文字必须准确，不得出现错字、乱码或英文。
onScreenText.en: Title: vertical brush calligraphy 「渔阳鼙鼓」, subtitle 「安史之乱与马嵬」, vermilion seal 「马嵬」 at upper right; subtitles: Simplified Chinese, bottom centre; all Chinese text must be exact, no garbled or Latin text.

narration: 天宝十四载十一月，安禄山在范阳起兵，以讨杨国忠为名，南下河北。一个月后，洛阳失守。次年六月，哥舒翰被迫出潼关迎战，大败。
玄宗仓皇出奔。行至马嵬驿，将士饥疲，陈玄礼请诛杨国忠。
杨国忠被乱兵所杀。六军仍然不肯前行。
玄宗沉默良久——
贵妃被缢死于佛堂。玄宗入蜀，太子北上灵武即位，是为肃宗。平叛之战还要持续七年。

prompt.en:
[Ink-wash video prompt] Tang dynasty (618–907) · "渔阳鼙鼓" (安史之乱与马嵬)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 106 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: Traditional Chinese ink-wash animation on xuan paper: layered ink tones from scorched black to pale wash, wet-and-dry brushwork, dry-brush flying-white strokes and splashed ink, generous negative space (liubai); strokes draw themselves on camera and bleed naturally into the paper; monochrome black-grey with restrained gold-orange and wine red accents and a touch of vermilion for seals, banners, blood or fire; figures in expressive xieyi line, simplified faces, not photorealistic.

Setting: Tang dynasty (618–907), 755 CE–756 CE — Chang'an wards and markets, Daming Palace, camel caravans, frontier beacon towers.

Characters:
- An Lushan (安禄山) — general, 燕 camp; futou headscarves, round-collar robes, mingguang plate armour; general in full armour, sword or weapon in hand; age as historically attested in 755 CE–756 CE
- Chen Xuanli (陈玄礼) — general, 唐 camp; futou headscarves, round-collar robes, mingguang plate armour; general in full armour, sword or weapon in hand; age as historically attested in 755 CE–756 CE
- Ge Shuhan (哥舒翰) — general, 唐 camp; futou headscarves, round-collar robes, mingguang plate armour; general in full armour, sword or weapon in hand; age as historically attested in 755 CE–756 CE
- Tang Xuanzong (唐玄宗) — ruler, 唐 camp; futou headscarves, round-collar robes, mingguang plate armour; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; age as historically attested in 755 CE–756 CE
- Yang Guifei (杨贵妃) — royal / consort, 唐 camp; futou headscarves, round-collar robes, mingguang plate armour; rich court dress, elaborate hair ornaments; age as historically attested in 755 CE–756 CE
- Yang Guozhong (杨国忠) — minister, 唐 camp; futou headscarves, round-collar robes, mingguang plate armour; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; age as historically attested in 755 CE–756 CE
- Gao Lishi (高力士) — commoner, 唐 camp; futou headscarves, round-collar robes, mingguang plate armour; commoner, artisan, attendant or soldier clothing as appropriate; age as historically attested in 755 CE–756 CE
- Li Heng (李亨) — royal / consort, 唐 camp; high-waisted ruqun with silk shawls, high chignon; rich court dress, elaborate hair ornaments; age as historically attested in 755 CE–756 CE

Storyboard:
Shot 1 (0–10 s, 10 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: background: distant mountains; midground: near hills and ground, palace pillars, palace eaves | Action: (scene action, Chinese) 长安，华清宫 | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper | Sound: ambience: guqin room tone | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「渔阳鼙鼓」 with vermilion seal 「马嵬」
Shot 2 (10–26 s, 16 s) | Camera: subtle handheld shake, urgent rhythm | Composition: subject: An Lushan, army ranks, forest of spears, cavalry | Action: (scene action, Chinese) 范阳鼙鼓 | Ink FX: ink-bleed transition from the previous shot; ink dispersing outward like hoofprints in wet ink | Sound: ambience: distant battle; SFX: distant drums, hoofbeats | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「天宝十四载十一月，安禄山在范阳起兵，以讨杨国忠为名，南下河北。一个月后，洛阳失守。次年六月，哥舒翰被迫出潼关迎战，大败。」
Shot 3 (26–50 s, 24 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: crenellated city wall, smoke; subject: Ge Shuhan | Action: (scene action, Chinese) 潼关失守 | Ink FX: ink-bleed transition from the previous shot | Sound: ambience: distant battle; SFX: clashing weapons | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「玄宗仓皇出奔。行至马嵬驿，将士饥疲，陈玄礼请诛杨国忠。」
Shot 4 (50–78 s, 28 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: army tents; subject: Chen Xuanli, crowd | Action: (scene action, Chinese) 马嵬驿，六军不发 | Ink FX: ink-bleed transition from the previous shot | Sound: ambience: crowd murmur; SFX: murmuring | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「杨国忠被乱兵所杀。六军仍然不肯前行。」
Shot 5 (78–90 s, 12 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: midground: trees, tree canopy; dry-brush calligraphy 「马嵬」 | Action: (scene action, Chinese) 佛堂前 | Ink FX: ink-bleed transition from the previous shot; vignette closing in from the corners; freeze into a still ink painting; ink splash with a single vermilion accent | Sound: ambience: lingering wind after battle; SFX: rustling silk | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「玄宗沉默良久——」
Shot 6 (90–100 s, 10 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; distant landscape | Action: (canonical outcome, Chinese) 贵妃被缢死于佛堂。玄宗入蜀，太子北上灵武即位，是为肃宗。平叛之战还要持续七年。 | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「贵妃被缢死于佛堂。玄宗入蜀，太子北上灵武即位，是为肃宗。平叛之战还要持续七年。」
Shot 7 (100–106 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper; a vertical kaishu quotation; vermilion seal 「马嵬」 at lower right | Action: the quotation writes itself stroke by stroke; the vermilion seal stamps last | Ink FX: brush writes stroke by stroke, vermilion seal paste slightly bleeding | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | On-screen text: quotation and its source

Sound: Music: pipa lute, tense tremolo or wistful phrases, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: guqin room tone, distant battle, crowd murmur, lingering wind after battle; SFX: distant drums, hoofbeats, clashing weapons, murmuring, rustling silk; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

On-screen text: Title: vertical brush calligraphy 「渔阳鼙鼓」, subtitle 「安史之乱与马嵬」, vermilion seal 「马嵬」 at upper right; subtitles: Simplified Chinese, bottom centre; all Chinese text must be exact, no garbled or Latin text.

Negative prompt: photorealistic, 3D render, CGI look, thick oil paint, cyberpunk, anime faces, beauty-filter faces, neon oversaturated colours, modern buildings, modern clothing, cars, power lines, plastic texture, Latin letters, garbled text, misspelled characters, watermark, signature, logo, extra limbs, malformed hands, distorted faces, flickering characters, jitter and tearing, anachronisms: Qing queues and magua jackets

strings.scene.tang.suiyang.title: 睢阳
strings.scene.tang.suiyang.subtitle: 张巡与许远
strings.vo.01: 安禄山起兵，张巡在雍丘起兵讨贼。城中箭尽，他束草为人，披上黑衣，夜里缒下城去，贼争射之，得箭数十万。
strings.vo.02: 至德二载正月，尹子琦率众十余万攻睢阳。太守许远向张巡求援，自以才不如巡，把兵权让给他。
strings.vo.03: 睢阳是江淮的屏障。城中只有数千人，他们守了一月又一月。
strings.vo.04: 粮尽了，南霁云突围去临淮，向贺兰进明乞师。贺兰进明嫉张巡的声威，不肯出兵，却设宴留他。
strings.scene.tang.suiyang.quote: 吾归破贼，必灭贺兰！此矢所以志也
strings.scene.tang.suiyang.fork.prompt: 此刻落笔，循哪一卷而书？
strings.scene.tang.suiyang.pick.canon: 正史 · 新旧《唐书》所载
strings.scene.tang.suiyang.canon.intro: 城上的弓手已经换了好几轮。张巡在城头巡视，叫得出每个士卒的名字。
strings.scene.tang.suiyang.end.canon: 十月，城中无力再战，睢阳陷落。张巡、许远、南霁云、雷万春等被执，张巡、南霁云等三十六人不屈被杀。三日后援军才到。江淮因此得以保全。
strings.scene.tang.suiyang.legend.disclaimer: 以下取自韩愈《张中丞传后叙》，是唐人据传闻写成的追记，部分细节不见于两《唐书》正传。对话为本作改编。
strings.scene.tang.suiyang.legend.intro: 韩愈说：南霁云拒绝了贺兰进明的宴席，拔刀断一指，血淋漓，以示贺兰。出城时，他抽箭射向佛寺浮图，箭入砖中半截。
strings.scene.tang.suiyang.end.legend: 箭留在塔上，南霁云回到了睢阳。汇流。
strings.scene.tang.suiyang.pick.whatif: 推演 · 若贺兰进明出兵（未开放）

style.zh: 中国传统水墨动画：宣纸纹理，焦、浓、重、淡、清五色墨层次，干湿浓淡变化，枯笔飞白与泼墨，大面积留白；笔触随镜头逐笔生成，墨色在纸上自然晕开；水墨黑白灰为主，点缀色克制：金橙、酒红，朱砂红只用于印章、旗帜、血或火光的一点；人物以写意线描为主，面部简笔，不做写实刻画。
style.en: Traditional Chinese ink-wash animation on xuan paper: layered ink tones from scorched black to pale wash, wet-and-dry brushwork, dry-brush flying-white strokes and splashed ink, generous negative space (liubai); strokes draw themselves on camera and bleed naturally into the paper; monochrome black-grey with restrained gold-orange and wine red accents and a touch of vermilion for seals, banners, blood or fire; figures in expressive xieyi line, simplified faces, not photorealistic.

setting.zh: 唐 · 唐天宝十五载至至德二载（756—757 年）。长安坊市、大明宫、驼队、边塞烽燧。
setting.en: Tang dynasty (618–907), 756 CE–757 CE — Chang'an wards and markets, Daming Palace, camel caravans, frontier beacon towers.

shots.vo: 安禄山起兵，张巡在雍丘起兵讨贼。城中箭尽，他束草为人，披上黑衣，夜里缒下城去，贼争射之，得箭数十万。至德二载正月，尹子琦率众十余万攻睢阳。太守许远向张巡求援，自以才不如巡，把兵权让给他。

shots.vo: 睢阳是江淮的屏障。城中只有数千人，他们守了一月又一月。
shots.zh: 镜头 3（26–50 秒，24 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：主体：雷万春、盾墙、弓箭｜动作：雷万春立城上，面中六矢｜水墨效果：墨晕转场（上一镜墨色晕开化入本镜）｜声音：环境：远处厮杀声；音效：放箭｜屏幕文字：引文「吾归破贼，必灭贺兰！此矢所以志也」竖排楷书；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「睢阳是江淮的屏障。城中只有数千人，他们守了一月又一月。」

shots.vo: 粮尽了，南霁云突围去临淮，向贺兰进明乞师。贺兰进明嫉张巡的声威，不肯出兵，却设宴留他。

shots.vo: 十月，城中无力再战，睢阳陷落。张巡、许远、南霁云、雷万春等被执，张巡、南霁云等三十六人不屈被杀。三日后援军才到。江淮因此得以保全。

sound.zh: 背景乐：琵琶，铿锵急切或婉转低回，随剧情由缓入急、高潮前骤停留白；环境声：远处厮杀声、夜风、战后余风；音效：箭雨、放箭、马蹄声；旁白：普通话，沉稳舒缓的纪录片语气，逐镜如下。
sound.en: Music: pipa lute, tense tremolo or wistful phrases, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: distant battle, night wind, lingering wind after battle; SFX: rain of arrows, arrow release, hoofbeats; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

narration: 安禄山起兵，张巡在雍丘起兵讨贼。城中箭尽，他束草为人，披上黑衣，夜里缒下城去，贼争射之，得箭数十万。至德二载正月，尹子琦率众十余万攻睢阳。太守许远向张巡求援，自以才不如巡，把兵权让给他。
睢阳是江淮的屏障。城中只有数千人，他们守了一月又一月。
粮尽了，南霁云突围去临淮，向贺兰进明乞师。贺兰进明嫉张巡的声威，不肯出兵，却设宴留他。
南霁云说——
十月，城中无力再战，睢阳陷落。张巡、许远、南霁云、雷万春等被执，张巡、南霁云等三十六人不屈被杀。三日后援军才到。江淮因此得以保全。
吾归破贼，必灭贺兰！此矢所以志也

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 106 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: Traditional Chinese ink-wash animation on xuan paper: layered ink tones from scorched black to pale wash, wet-and-dry brushwork, dry-brush flying-white strokes and splashed ink, generous negative space (liubai); strokes draw themselves on camera and bleed naturally into the paper; monochrome black-grey with restrained gold-orange and wine red accents and a touch of vermilion for seals, banners, blood or fire; figures in expressive xieyi line, simplified faces, not photorealistic.

Setting: Tang dynasty (618–907), 756 CE–757 CE — Chang'an wards and markets, Daming Palace, camel caravans, frontier beacon towers.

strings.scene.tang.guoziyi.title: 单骑退回纥
strings.scene.tang.guoziyi.subtitle: 郭子仪
strings.vo.01: 仆固怀恩反，诱吐蕃、回纥、党项等数十万众入寇。长安戒严。
strings.vo.02: 郭子仪以万人屯泾阳，被胡骑重重包围。仆固怀恩却在途中暴病而死，回纥与吐蕃争长，互不服气。
strings.vo.03: 郭子仪说：回纥曾与我并肩作战，我当挺身前去说之。诸将请选铁骑五百护卫，子仪说：此适足为害也。
strings.vo.04: 其子郭晞叩马苦谏，郭子仪以鞭击其手，带着数骑开门而出。
strings.vo.05: 他脱下头盔，放下枪，走了过去——
strings.scene.tang.guoziyi.fork.prompt: 此刻落笔，循哪一卷而书？
strings.anchor.huaienru: 仆固怀恩引吐蕃、回纥入寇
strings.anchor.lingtai: 唐与回纥合破吐蕃于灵台西原
strings.scene.tang.guoziyi.pick.canon: 正史 · 《旧唐书》《资治通鉴》所载
strings.scene.tang.guoziyi.canon.intro: 泾阳城门打开了，只出来几匹马。回纥的骑兵张弓搭箭，看着为首的白发老将。
strings.scene.tang.guoziyi.end.canon: 回纥与唐重申旧好，合击吐蕃于灵台西原，大破之。一场席卷关中的大难，就此消解。
strings.scene.tang.guoziyi.legend.disclaimer: 以下按蔡东藩《唐史演义》第六十回改编，主干同正史，对话为小说增饰。
strings.scene.tang.guoziyi.legend.intro: 演义写郭子仪在回纥营中与药葛罗执酒为誓，回纥人纷纷说：令公真在，我等愿效死力。
strings.scene.tang.guoziyi.end.legend: 盟誓成。演义汇回正史：灵台西原之战。
strings.scene.tang.guoziyi.pick.whatif: 推演 · 若郭子仪带五百铁骑（未开放）

style.zh: 中国传统水墨动画：宣纸纹理，焦、浓、重、淡、清五色墨层次，干湿浓淡变化，枯笔飞白与泼墨，大面积留白；笔触随镜头逐笔生成，墨色在纸上自然晕开；水墨黑白灰为主，点缀色克制：金橙、酒红，朱砂红只用于印章、旗帜、血或火光的一点；人物以写意线描为主，面部简笔，不做写实刻画。
style.en: Traditional Chinese ink-wash animation on xuan paper: layered ink tones from scorched black to pale wash, wet-and-dry brushwork, dry-brush flying-white strokes and splashed ink, generous negative space (liubai); strokes draw themselves on camera and bleed naturally into the paper; monochrome black-grey with restrained gold-orange and wine red accents and a touch of vermilion for seals, banners, blood or fire; figures in expressive xieyi line, simplified faces, not photorealistic.

narration: 仆固怀恩反，诱吐蕃、回纥、党项等数十万众入寇。长安戒严。郭子仪以万人屯泾阳，被胡骑重重包围。仆固怀恩却在途中暴病而死，回纥与吐蕃争长，互不服气。
郭子仪说：回纥曾与我并肩作战，我当挺身前去说之。诸将请选铁骑五百护卫，子仪说：此适足为害也。
其子郭晞叩马苦谏，郭子仪以鞭击其手，带着数骑开门而出。
他脱下头盔，放下枪，走了过去——
回纥与唐重申旧好，合击吐蕃于灵台西原，大破之。一场席卷关中的大难，就此消解。
果吾父也

strings.scene.tang.caizhou.title: 雪夜入蔡州
strings.scene.tang.caizhou.subtitle: 李愬
strings.vo.01: 淮西吴少阳死，其子吴元济自领军务，抗拒朝命。朝廷用兵三年，不能下。
strings.vo.02: 李愬到唐邓，示弱以懈敌心。他擒得淮西骁将李祐，不杀，反而释缚厚待，与之同帐而谋。
strings.vo.03: 李祐说：元济的精兵都在洄曲和边境，守蔡州的都是老弱，可以乘虚直抵其城。
strings.vo.04: 元和十二年十月，李愬夜出文城，东行六十里，至张柴村，杀其守者。诸将问去哪里，李愬说：入蔡州取吴元济。
strings.vo.05: 这一夜大风雪，旌旗裂，人马冻死者相望——
strings.scene.tang.caizhou.fork.prompt: 此刻落笔，循哪一卷而书？
strings.scene.tang.caizhou.pick.canon: 正史 · 《旧唐书》《资治通鉴》所载
strings.scene.tang.caizhou.canon.intro: 张柴村的守军刚刚被杀尽。李愬下令：不许停，继续向东。诸将这才知道要去哪里，相顾失色。
strings.scene.tang.caizhou.end.canon: 天亮时官军已入外城。吴元济在城上被擒，送长安斩首。淮西平定，河北诸镇震恐。
strings.scene.tang.caizhou.legend.disclaimer: 以下是唐代文坛的一段公案：韩愈奉命撰《平淮西碑》，归功裴度；李愬之妻入宫诉碑不实，宪宗命磨去碑文，令段文昌重撰。李商隐有《韩碑》诗记此事。
strings.scene.tang.caizhou.legend.intro: 碑立起来没多久，就被磨平了。晚唐的李商隐写诗说：碑高三丈字如手，负以灵鳌蟠以螭。
strings.scene.tang.caizhou.end.legend: 碑可以磨平，雪夜的故事仍然流传。汇流。
strings.scene.tang.caizhou.pick.whatif: 推演 · 若李祐被杀（未开放）

style.zh: 中国传统水墨动画：宣纸纹理，焦、浓、重、淡、清五色墨层次，干湿浓淡变化，枯笔飞白与泼墨，大面积留白；笔触随镜头逐笔生成，墨色在纸上自然晕开；水墨黑白灰为主，点缀色克制：金橙、酒红，朱砂红只用于印章、旗帜、血或火光的一点；人物以写意线描为主，面部简笔，不做写实刻画。
style.en: Traditional Chinese ink-wash animation on xuan paper: layered ink tones from scorched black to pale wash, wet-and-dry brushwork, dry-brush flying-white strokes and splashed ink, generous negative space (liubai); strokes draw themselves on camera and bleed naturally into the paper; monochrome black-grey with restrained gold-orange and wine red accents and a touch of vermilion for seals, banners, blood or fire; figures in expressive xieyi line, simplified faces, not photorealistic.

[Ink-wash video prompt] Tang dynasty (618–907) · "雪夜入蔡州" (李愬)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 106 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: Traditional Chinese ink-wash animation on xuan paper: layered ink tones from scorched black to pale wash, wet-and-dry brushwork, dry-brush flying-white strokes and splashed ink, generous negative space (liubai); strokes draw themselves on camera and bleed naturally into the paper; monochrome black-grey with restrained gold-orange and wine red accents and a touch of vermilion for seals, banners, blood or fire; figures in expressive xieyi line, simplified faces, not photorealistic.

Setting: Tang dynasty (618–907), 817 CE — Chang'an wards and markets, Daming Palace, camel caravans, frontier beacon towers.

strings.scene.tang.huangchao.title: 冲天香阵
strings.scene.tang.huangchao.subtitle: 黄巢入长安
strings.vo.01: 唐末，水旱连年，赋役沉重。盐贩王仙芝、黄巢先后起事。
strings.vo.02: 王仙芝战死之后，黄巢号冲天大将军，转战江淮、岭南，又挥师北上。
strings.vo.03: 广明元年冬，义军攻破潼关，唐僖宗仓皇出奔成都。
strings.vo.04: 黄巢入长安，即皇帝位，国号大齐。
strings.vo.05: 后人把一首咏菊的诗系于他的名下——
strings.scene.tang.huangchao.fork.prompt: 此刻落笔，循哪一卷而书？
strings.scene.tang.huangchao.pick.canon: 正史 · 《新唐书》、《旧唐书》所载
strings.scene.tang.huangchao.canon.intro: 长安城里，一个落第的举子收拾行装出了城。多年以后，他带着数十万人回来了。
strings.scene.tang.huangchao.end.canon: 数年后，唐军与沙陀李克用收复长安，部将朱温降唐。884 年，黄巢败死于狼虎谷。唐朝已名存实亡。
strings.scene.tang.huangchao.legend.disclaimer: 以下这首咏菊诗传为黄巢落第后所作，见于宋以后的笔记诗话，作者归属难以确证。“黄巢杀人八百万”之类民间夸张说法，本作不采。
strings.scene.tang.huangchao.legend.intro: 传说黄巢应进士不第，写下一首咏菊诗，诗中有“冲天香阵透长安，满城尽带黄金甲”之句。
strings.scene.tang.huangchao.end.legend: 诗句流传后世，作者之谜未解。传说汇回正史：大齐在长安只维持了两年多。
strings.scene.tang.huangchao.pick.whatif: 推演 · 若黄巢中第（未开放）

style.zh: 中国传统水墨动画：宣纸纹理，焦、浓、重、淡、清五色墨层次，干湿浓淡变化，枯笔飞白与泼墨，大面积留白；笔触随镜头逐笔生成，墨色在纸上自然晕开；水墨黑白灰为主，点缀色克制：金橙、酒红，朱砂红只用于印章、旗帜、血或火光的一点；人物以写意线描为主，面部简笔，不做写实刻画。
style.en: Traditional Chinese ink-wash animation on xuan paper: layered ink tones from scorched black to pale wash, wet-and-dry brushwork, dry-brush flying-white strokes and splashed ink, generous negative space (liubai); strokes draw themselves on camera and bleed naturally into the paper; monochrome black-grey with restrained gold-orange and wine red accents and a touch of vermilion for seals, banners, blood or fire; figures in expressive xieyi line, simplified faces, not photorealistic.
